cleavage agent: digested in-gel with 100 ng Trypsin (Promega V5111).
enrichment method: affinity chromatography using Protein G HP SpinTrap columns
Reactive protein fractions were subsequently purified by affinity chromatography using Protein G HP SpinTrap columns (GE Healthcare).
fractionation method: separating cell extracts based on molecular weight using a Sephacryl S200 HR column
protein fractions were obtained by separating cell extracts based on molecular weight using a Sephacryl S200 HR column (GE Healthcare, Hertfordshire, UK).
labeling: Protein bands were visualized by Coomassie blue staining, excised, destained, washed, reduced, alkylated, and then digested in-gel with 100 ng Trypsin (Promega V5111).
